description: Upload a model trained anywhere as a new version of a hosted model: the ONNX file as base64 (at most 4 MiB) and the spec that maps request fields to its inputs. It is checked before it is stored: it must parse, use only operators the hosted runtime runs (scikit-learn, XGBoost and LightGBM tree ensembles, linear models, small neural networks), take as many inputs as the spec lists, and give a finite answer of the right shape on a test row; otherwise it answers 422 naming the problem. Stored as a candidate unless promote is true. The hosted MCP endpoint (/api/mcp/rpc) takes requests of at most 64 KiB, so send a larger file with the stdio server, the tool packages or POST /api/hosted-models/{model_id}/versions. Answers 404 not_released while hosted models (the hosted-pricing-models release) are not switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with function publish scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

artifact_base64.description: The .onnx file, base64 encoded. At most 4 MiB before encoding.

model_id.description: The hosted model's id: id on a list_hosted_models result.

notes.description: Optional notes kept with the version.

promote.description: Make it the active version at once. Defaults to false: stored as a candidate.

spec.description: How request fields become the model's inputs.

inputs.description: One entry per model input column, in column order.

missing.description: number inputs: what to feed when the field is missing. Without it, a missing value is NaN, which tree models treat as missing.

source.description: Where the value is read from the request: current_price, unit_cost, unit_cost_ratio, customer_segment, geo, product_id, product_type, buyer_type, channel, currency, or metadata.<key>.

type.description: number feeds the value; category feeds its position in vocabulary (-1 when unknown).

vocabulary.description: category inputs, required for one: the values in code order.

kind.description: Must be the model's own kind.

output.description: A price model only, and required for one: whether it outputs the price itself or a ratio of current_price.

name: upload_hosted_model_version
